01. Introduction & Scope

Welcome to hexboardgame.com ("Online Hex Board Game", "we", "our", or "us"). We provide a free, browser-based turn-based strategy board game inspired by the classic hexagonal title Hexxagon. We are dedicated to respecting and protecting the privacy of everyone who visits our site.

This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, and protected when you visit or play on https://hexboardgame.com (the "Website"). By using our Website, you agree to the practices outlined in this policy.

02. Information Collection & Client-Side Storage

We believe in data minimization. You do not need to register, create an account, or provide personal information such as names, addresses, or payment details to play our games.

A. Local Browser Storage (`localStorage`)

To maintain your match progress and personal preferences across browser sessions, the game engine stores preference flags directly on your device using standard browser localStorage. This data resides solely on your computer or mobile device and is never transmitted to or stored on our servers:

  • Sound synthesized volume settings and audio mute state.
  • Player battle win/loss tallies and combat statistics.
  • Preferred board geometry arena and default AI difficulty tier.
  • Visual piece theme preferences (e.g., Rubies vs Pearls).
B. Direct Inquiries

If you choose to contact us via email, we will only use the contact information you provide (such as your email address) to respond to your specific question or feedback.

03. Third-Party Advertising & Cookie Policy

To keep hexboardgame.com free and accessible to players worldwide, we work with or may work with third-party advertising networks, including Google AdSense, to display advertisements when you visit our website.

Required Advertising Disclosures:
  • Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites.
  • Google's use of advertising cookies (such as the DoubleClick cookie) enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visits to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.
  • Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting:Google Ads Settings (https://www.google.com/settings/ads).
  • Alternatively, users can opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting:aboutads.info/choices ornetworkadvertising.org.

You can also configure your web browser settings to block, delete, or alert you about cookies. Please note that disabling cookies may affect certain web features across different websites.

04. Analytics, Web Vitals & Technical Logs

When you access our Website, standard server logs and aggregated performance telemetry may be recorded automatically by hosting infrastructure. This includes anonymized technical details such as your browser type, operating system, referring URL, time of visit, and Core Web Vitals performance metrics.

These logs are used exclusively for security monitoring, preventing automated fraud, diagnosing technical issues, and ensuring optimal load times across devices. They do not identify individual visitors personally.

05. European Privacy Rights (GDPR & UK GDPR)

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, or Switzerland, you have specific statutory rights regarding your data under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):

Right of Access & PortabilityRequest confirmation of data processing and obtain a portable copy of any personal data.
Right to Erasure ("To Be Forgotten")Request deletion of personal data where retention is no longer necessary.
Right to RectificationRequest correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal records.
Right to Object & Withdraw ConsentWithdraw consent for advertising cookies or object to legitimate interest processing.

06. California Consumer Privacy Rights (CCPA / CPRA)

Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), California residents are entitled to know what categories of personal data are collected and how they are used:

  • No Sale or Sharing of Personal Data: hexboardgame.com does not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for financial compensation.
  • Right to Know & Delete: You have the right to request what personal information we collect and request its deletion.
  • Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you or degrade your gameplay experience for exercising any of your privacy rights.

07. Children's Online Privacy Protection (COPPA)

Protecting the privacy of children is important to us. hexboardgame.com is a general audience gaming website that does not knowingly collect, request, or retain personal identifiable information from children under the age of 13 (or under 16 in the EEA/UK).

If you are a parent or guardian and believe that your child has provided us with personal information, please reach out to us at support@hexboardgame.com, and we will promptly delete such records.

08. Security & Data Retention

We implement industry-standard administrative and technical security measures to maintain the safety of our website. All traffic between your browser and our edge servers is encrypted using modern SSL/TLS (HTTPS) encryption. We retain server logs only as long as necessary for security auditing and diagnostic purposes.

09. External Links & Services

Our website may contain links to external third-party resources or informational pages. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or policies of third-party websites. We encourage you to review the individual privacy policies of any third-party websites you visit.

10. Policy Updates & Contact Information

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect operational, legal, or regulatory changes. Any updates will be published directly on this page with an updated "Last Updated" date.
